ideas.idea: Use NuxtLink instead of the button, and remove unused useRouter
ideas.why: This restates the known button/router.push problem; the cleanup of useRouter is trivial.

ideas.idea: Add per-page useSeoMeta and a titleTemplate in app.vue
ideas.why: Pages have only the shared title and description, and giving index and guides their own titles and descriptions is a concrete fix.

ideas.idea: Add canonical links plus Open Graph and Twitter card tags, with a site URL set in config
ideas.why: This is accurate but standard advice for any site, and its effect on discoverability is small.

ideas.idea: Add real route content to the pages (distances, grades, ascent, named routes, a quotable summary)
ideas.why: The pages are only an h1 and one line, so there is nothing substantive for search engines or AI assistants to read or cite.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD structured data (WebSite, Organization, ItemList/Article, Place/TouristTrip)
ideas.why: No structured data exists, but it would add little on pages with almost no content, and the advice is not specific to this site.

ideas.idea: Decide an explicit AI-crawler policy in robots.txt (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, etc.)
ideas.why: Setting a bot policy is true of any site and has little effect here.
The report presents it as a cheap addition, but not having llms.txt is a deliberate, acceptable choice and it does not help the site get found.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap with @nuxtjs/sitemap and add lastmod
ideas.why: A two-URL sitemap is fine as it is, and lastmod and generation add little.

ideas.idea: Remove the double blocking on /admin: require auth, or allow crawling and use a noindex header
ideas.why: It reverses the deliberate choice that /admin is noindex and disallowed in robots.txt.

ideas.idea: Plan favicon, image alt text and og:image for future images
ideas.why: There are no images yet, so this is speculative advice that applies to any site.

ideas.idea: Use prerender routeRules as an alternative to removing ssr:false
ideas.why: It is a variant of the known ssr:false problem.

ideas.idea: Narrow the /guides noindex middleware to specific paths if some guides should be hidden
ideas.why: It is an extension of the known noindex-on-/guides problem.
